youtube.title: In This City, One Yawn Puts Everyone to Sleep
youtube.description: An original animated tiny satire: in this city, one yawn puts everyone who sees it to sleep – instantly. Ted, a bus driver who hasn't slept in three days, has to get forty passengers across the longest bridge in town without seeing a single yawn. Pure fiction – the city, the rule and all characters are invented.

tiktok.caption: In this city, one yawn puts everyone to sleep. Ted has to drive 40 people across the bridge without seeing a single one. Did you yawn? 😴 (fiction)
